change: Cover old live scheduler -> current root Fast wrapper -> native CLI without mutating live, leased trees, tasks, or running processes.

routing.exec: Only explicit default_permissions=learner, using the last override before --, enters learner policy.
routing.sandbox: Only explicit -P/--permission-profile learner, using the last override before --, enters learner policy. No model flag added.
routing.other_calls: Ops, play, app-server, no-profile calls and inherited LEARNER_* env keep Fast and original model/effort.
routing.native_boundary: Learner exec replaces legacy model/effort with gpt-6-astra/xhigh, strips tier, retains isolation flags, emits a static stderr effective-policy line only when replacing old values. Sandbox child arguments after -- remain byte-for-byte argv entries.
routing.legacy_jsonl: Older task source may still declare its old model; the native boundary argv and stderr effective policy are the evidence of the actual request.
